meta.notes: D1 is chosen for standby as it has a slightly longer flight time and can cover more ground quickly. G1 is tasked with T6 and T7 due to its payload capacity and endurance. M1 handles T1 and T5 as it has a smaller payload but can carry the first-aid kit. M2 takes on T9 and T10 for its larger payload capacity. D2 is assigned T3 and T8 as it can fly quickly and has a thermal camera useful for visual inspection.
